brief.objective: Minimise closest Bandit-Lady distance, ideally reaching within 5 m of the Lady before t=240 s, while keeping the Guard outside about 150 m. The Lady miss distance dominates the score: staying at 2600 m costs about 6.8e6, while a 100 m Guard pass costs only about 1e4. Never get captured.
brief.approach: Accelerate along-track toward the Lady early (we need about 11 m/s average to cover 2600 m in 240 s), using a radial offset of a few hundred metres (prefer radial-out, x>0) so we pass around the Guard rather than through it; use EVADE_GUARD only when it is inside about 300 m and closing, and steer the sidestep toward the Lady. Expect along-track thrust to induce Coriolis radial drift (about 0.1 m/s^2 at 20 m/s), and correct it with the radial axis before it carries us off the Lady's line. Once past the Guard, APPROACH_LADY on the braking glide slope at no more than 20 m/s, then cap at 2 m/s inside 100 m and accept a close Guard pass in preference to aborting the final approach. Budget about 25 m/s for acceleration, 25 m/s for braking and the rest for evasion; never COAST while the Guard is closing inside 500 m.
phases: T0-20s: burn forward along-track to about 15-20 m/s closing and start a radial-out offset of about 200-300 m (waypoint around [250, -900, 0]).
Bypass: keep the Guard outside 150 m and EVADE_GUARD around it toward the Lady if it closes inside 300 m; null the Coriolis radial drift.
Run-in: once the Guard is behind or abeam, APPROACH_LADY on the glide slope at 20 m/s or less, braking so speed falls about linearly with range.
Terminal: inside 100 m, close at 2 m/s or less to within 5 m of the Lady; keep evading only if the Guard is within 30 m and closing fast.
Fallback: if time or fuel runs short (under about 15% fuel left), BRAKE and HOLD_STANDOFF as close to the Lady as possible while keeping Guard distance.
